notes:
This is an early build, released to consoles set to Latest Updates.

More PC games start. Wine now has the upstream fix for games made with .NET, so
a game like They Are Billions starts. If a game that ran before stops starting,
set its Wine version to Original in the game's settings. The x86 translator now
handles programs that rewrite their own code, so FTL starts in seconds instead
of stopping on "Unable to load function". Full x87 precision is no longer
switched on by itself, and this update turns it off once for every PC game: it
made games like FTL too slow to play. Turn it back on for a game that shows
garbled text.

PC game windows no longer get a title bar. A Steam download that uses Steam now
starts the Steam client with the game when the client is installed and signed
in; untick "Start the Steam client with this game" on the web page to stop it.

Uploading PC games: a folder holding only an installer goes up as an installer,
a repack that only partly unpacks is kept whole and runs its own setup on the
console, and an installer with a file over 4 GB, like The Witcher 2's, unpacks
onto the console's storage. A GOG installer built from Galaxy's files keeps its
game. The web page's Files window now works for a game kept on the console's
storage, so mods can go in.

Wii U: Paper Mario: Color Splash boots. Cemu now handles a kind of memory access
the Switch's processor refuses.

Boot splash: the update badge is clean, with no black band and no sign text
beside it. Any PNG or JPG background can be the boot splash, with a small SCCM
Retro logo in its corner: Settings, Display and Sound, Appearance, Boot splash,
or the web page's Backgrounds tab. A splash you made yourself is left alone.

Web page: Admin access on the Debug tab lets Browse all files change the SD
card's Atmosphere, emuMMC, Nintendo and homebrew files, and adds Upload, New
folder and Download. Boot files stay locked, and it turns off at every restart.
The PC games report shows the game's windows and which one has focus.

Overclocking: Console Info shows the CPU high vMin. Saving a RAM speed of 2700
MHz or more sets it to 860 mV, up from 850, since faster memory needs more CPU
voltage, and the RAM page now says so. If a RAM setting saved without a test
does not start, hold POWER for 15 seconds, power on and pick SCCM Retro (Safe
Mode).

Bluetooth's Find button is gone.

The custom boot splash and Paper Mario were tested on one console, the .NET fix
with They Are Billions, and the Steam client change with Spacewar. Original Wine
stays as a fallback while more games are tried.

stable.notes:
The 2.41 changes, now on the Stable channel. If this console was on 2.40.0,
it also gets the whole 2.40 series, summed up at the end.

This update carries a new boot script: the console restarts once for the
update and once more on its own about a minute after the first boot. Do not
power off while it says part 2 of 2.

The SD card's fastest mode (DDR200) is now used on Samsung cards only, as
Switchroot does. Other cards run in the standard mode: if yours used the
fast mode, games load a little slower, but SanDisk cards, which cannot run
it reliably on the Switch, no longer get read errors under load. If a
Samsung card gives read errors, turn DDR200 off in the SCCM Retro app's Boot
settings.

The SCCM Retro app on the Homebrew menu is now one app: Launch SCCM Retro,
Launch in Safe Mode (stock clocks and voltages, once), Options (WiFi and
Bluetooth, boot settings, auto launch), and installing or removing SCCM
Retro on an SD card. The separate installer and calibration apps are
removed.

Swap A and B now applies only to Gen1Recomp and Moonlight, the two games
that offer it.

New background: Arcade, in Settings, Display and Sound, Appearance.

From 2.40.0, also: the console boots in about 28 seconds instead of about
50; Ocarina of Time and Majora's Mask, and Mario Kart Wii as a native port
with Retro Rewind online, on Ports and Apps; a PC Games tab for Windows
games; auto save for RetroArch, 3DS and PS2 games; Wii U, GameCube, WiFi
and volume button fixes; and a security fix to install permissions.
